algorithm.profile_rule: mean unit document vector per author; nearest profile by cosine

whole_document.interpretation: The current interpretable content-light feature family does not account for LUAR's stronger whole-passage author separation, especially for Joel.

equal_50_word.interpretation: Short-passage results disagree by author and remain unstable; neither lane supports operational short-text calibration.

interpretation.primary_observation: LUAR's whole-document advantage is not reproduced by Pangram's current dependency-free content-light feature family. This supports further deep-representation validation but does not prove that LUAR is topic-independent or causally measuring idiolect.
interpretation.next_test: Run a deterministic word-order perturbation through the pinned LUAR model while preserving lexical token multiset and non-word separator sequence. Measure original-vs-shuffled embedding cosine, attribution retention/change, and author-profile cosine displacement on the same held-out documents.
